entities.name: Wall
entities.description: A creature type representing barriers such as walls, fences, gates and magical shields; this page is mostly about its game history.

entities.name: Pramikon, Sky Rampart
entities.description: The first legendary wall, introduced in Commander 2019.

entities.name: Wall of Mulch
entities.description: A wall described as the closest thing to a wall lord.

events.summary: Walls are introduced in Alpha with ten walls across all colors.
events.quote: Walls were introduced in Alpha , which featured ten walls across all colors.

events.summary: With Champions of Kamigawa the Wall type no longer prevents attacking; the defender keyword takes over and older Walls get errata.
events.quote: Previously printed Walls recieved an errata giving them defender .

events.summary: Commander 2019 introduces the first legendary wall, Pramikon, Sky Rampart.
events.quote: Commander 2019 introduced the first legendary wall Pramikon, Sky Rampart .
